title: O Tannenbaum (O Christmas Tree)
attribution: Melody: German folk tune (printed 1799, from the student song "Lauriger Horatius"); words by Ernst Anschütz (1824), after Joachim August Zarnack (1819). Both are public domain worldwide. (The familiar English "how lovely are thy branches" text has no verifiable pre-1930 author, so the original German words are used here.)
